source_batch.unit_label: BRBL C U05: Distinguish ARC incorporation, statutory registration and dated NOF requirements

facts.statement: Courseware describes statutory RBI registration, owned-fund framework, fitness/professional and prudential conditions. Its 2crore wording is not the applicable RBI NOF floor. Retained RBI directions paragraphs8 and14-18 supply dated requirements.
Registration and NOF are dated regulatory requirements; ordinary ongoing NOF300crore, existing ARC deadline31March2026; resolution applicant has separate1000crore NOF and further conditions.

payload.title: A company certificate is not the ARC regulatory permission
payload.core_explanation_md:
Incorporation creates the company; it does not by itself authorise the statutory ARC business. Section 3 registration and the applicable RBI conditions require separate evidence. Professional, fit-and-proper and prudential checks are substantive requirements rather than a reason to assume that incorporation completed the process.

For the retained RBI Directions snapshot updated 10 March 2026, the minimum ongoing NOF is INR 300 crore, with the stated existing-ARC deadline of 31 March 2026. The courseware two-crore statutory wording must not be taught as this RBI floor. Resolution-applicant activity has a separate INR 1,000 crore NOF condition and further requirements. Meeting a capital number alone does not establish every permission.

self_check.prompt_text: Does incorporation or meeting a capital number alone establish all ARC permissions?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Registration, applicable prudential requirements and activity-specific conditions remain separate.

payload.stem_md: A due-diligence file contains only company incorporation evidence and quotes the book two-crore wording as the RBI ARC NOF floor at 30 June 2026. Which correction is needed?

options.text_md: Accept it because incorporation replaces RBI registration
options.explanation_md: Corporate existence and statutory ARC registration are distinct.

options.text_md: Replace every regulatory check with the company registered address
options.explanation_md: An address does not establish the permissions or prudential requirements.

options.text_md: Obtain ARC registration evidence and apply the dated RBI NOF requirements
options.explanation_md: The retained Directions supply the later regulatory floor rather than the book shorthand.

options.text_md: Treat every registered company as an ARC
options.explanation_md: Registration under company law is not the section 3 certificate.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The retained Directions supply the later regulatory floor rather than the book shorthand.

payload.stem_md: An ARC meets the ordinary NOF floor and concludes that this alone proves eligibility for resolution-applicant activity under the retained Directions. What is missing?

options.text_md: The separate activity-specific NOF and other conditions
options.explanation_md: Paragraph18 imposes additional conditions beyond ordinary ARC capital compliance.

options.text_md: Only a new logo describing the activity
A rule that every ARC is exempt from all activity restrictions
options.explanation_md: The retained Directions distinguish permissible activities and their conditions.

options.text_md: An assumption that NOF means gross assets
options.explanation_md: NOF is a regulatory measure, not merely gross asset value.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Paragraph18 imposes additional conditions beyond ordinary ARC capital compliance.
